vt pretio Haeredibus depenso, Liber cui extremam
Auctor manum impofuerat, in meam deueniret
potestatem. Hunc postea, vbi primum per tempus
licuit, diligenter typis meis excudendum tradidi.

nimi pendeo. Illud quidem certè mihi minimè

page.notes: The woodcut initial is an ornamental C/U-shaped figure; its letter is read as U (Vm). Some letters at the page edge are faint. Scan shows heavy staining at right edge; no text lost there.
